class.brief_description: Used for conditions and actions. You should define your own [code]on_tick()[/code] method where you do your logic.
class.description: The leaf node is used for conditions and actions. You should define your own [method NNBTTaskNodes.on_tick] method where you do your logic. A leaf that does not override [method NNBTTaskNodes.on_tick] returns [code]Status.FAILURE[/code] and reports an error once per node instance. Example: [gdscript] func on_tick(blackboard: Variant, delta: float) -> Status: return Status.SUCCESS [/gdscript] [method NNBTTaskNodes.on_tick] must return [code]SKIP[/code] (-2), [code]FAILURE[/code] (-1), [code]RUNNING[/code] (0) or [code]SUCCESS[/code] (1); any other return value logs an engine error and is treated as [code]FAILURE[/code].
